newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, market seen as stable.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, market seen as stable.

text.p: Croatian stocks traded mixed on Wednesday with marginal gains, and traders said they expected the market to remain stable but without any drastic price movements.
"Most issues have reached the ceiling for this week," one trader said, adding that prices would most probably move only a few kuna up or down.
* Of nine issues that traded, five rose, three were flat and one fell.
* Zagrebacka Banka added 20 kuna, closing at 950, with 1,140 shares changing hands.
* Confectioner Kras was up 20 kuna to 530, selling 684 shares.
* Of five hoteliers that traded, three rose and two were flat:
- Jadranturist gained 28 kuna to 260, trading 908 units.
- Riviera Porec up 10 kuna to 115, with 635 shares sold.
- Laguna inched up five kuna to 905, with 205 shares sold.
- Suncani Hvar was flat at 45 kuna, with 855 shares sold.
- Arenturist also flat at 100 kuna, selling 1,118 shares.
* Most actively traded food processor Podravka remained flat at 250 kuna, trading 5,827 shares.
* The only loser drugs firm Pliva lost 300 kuna to close at 13,200 on volume of 22 shares.
* First issue of public debt refinancing bonds traded at 95.25 percent of face value, on turnover of 4.4 million kuna.
* Daily volume halved at 11,394 shares, turnover at 8.2 million kuna. * Central bank's exchange rate: 5.3822 kuna = $1.
